design: P5.14-Y2 — offset reproducibility on a second candidate
status: FROZEN — NOT AUTHORIZED TO RUN. Held for the author's decision.
instruction: author, 2026-09-12: repeat the cold/warm pair on a second candidate; predeclare in offset terms; state the achievable numerical resolution BEFORE reading any result; if the achievable resolution is coarser than the bar, that is itself the finding and a more important one than either outcome.

the_bar.source_note: PLANNING_SIGNAL = 33031.0 at p510_e_criteria.py:53 is the PRE-stabilized gap; 32.87 and 22.09 are the stabilized oracle's. They are the same quantity on two different oracles and must not be divided by one another.
the_bar.requirement: rankings are formed from differences within one path, so a CONSTANT offset cancels exactly. For the ranking to survive, the offset must reproduce across candidates to within about 33 absolute units out of ~1.06e6, i.e. 0.0031%.

PRE-REGISTERED RESOLUTION ANALYSIS — the.question: what resolution on the offset is achievable at all, before any result is read?
PRE-REGISTERED RESOLUTION ANALYSIS — the.arithmetic_source_is_not_the_limit: the warm path reproduced a pre-C3 run to 16 digits, so the pipeline is bitwise deterministic; floating-point representation gives ~1e-7 absolute on 8.28e8 and is irrelevant here

the_actual_limit_is_the_stopping_point.reasoning: Q is read where the run stops, and each run stops when its per-cycle objective change falls under the tolerance. Q is therefore known only to within roughly the size of the last step taken.
the_actual_limit_is_the_stopping_point.error_bar_on_the_offset: sum of the two cells' terminal steps = 766062.1 for the cold/warm_fixed pair
the_actual_limit_is_the_stopping_point.verdict: the measured offset 1055598 is only 1.4x its own error bar 766062, and the bar the ranking requires is 33 units — about 23,000x finer than the error bar. THE EXPERIMENT AS POSED CANNOT MEET ITS BAR, and this is established before running it.

the_finding_this_yields.statement: The objective criterion -- the only rho-independent member of the composite test -- is itself far too loose to resolve the ranking it is being used to support.
the_finding_this_yields.consequence: Q is defined only to within ~+/-8.3e5 by its own stopping rule, while the quantity to be resolved is 32.87. The empirical cross-depth uncertainty of 22.09 is FOUR ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE smaller than that bound, which means the templated ranking works -- when it works -- by the determinism of identical code paths cancelling the slack, not because the criterion resolves anything. That is fragile: anything that perturbs a trajectory (a different candidate, a solver retry, a code edit) can move a stopping point by up to a tolerance width.

cost_of_a_resolution_adequate_oracle.method: the cold cell's late per-cycle decrement ratio is 0.8216 (mean of the last four); continuing until the decrement falls under the 33-unit bar
cost_of_a_resolution_adequate_oracle.EXTRAPOLATION_WARNING: this is an extrapolation of a decrement ratio, which is exactly the operation that has gone wrong three times in this project. The ratio is not stable -- it ran 0.87 -> 0.98 in the R trajectory and 0.8216 here -- so this is an ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE INDICATION ONLY and must never be quoted as a cost.
cost_of_a_resolution_adequate_oracle.note: the resulting total (~1683 + ~2588 = ~4271) lands near the withdrawn 4600 figure by a completely different route. That is a coincidence and does NOT vindicate the withdrawn number, whose derivation was wrong.

recommended_redesign.why: measuring the offset as a subtraction of two ~8.28e8 numbers read at two different criterion-dependent stopping points cannot reach 33 units
recommended_redesign.primary_measurement: compare the two initializations at a COMMON, CRITERION-FREE reference: a fixed cycle budget identical for both cells, with the offset reported together with each cell's per-cycle objective change AT that budget as an explicit error bar
recommended_redesign.secondary: repeat on the second candidate and report whether the offset reproduces WITHIN THE STATED ERROR BAR -- a far weaker claim than the 33-unit bar, and the strongest one the current stopping rule supports
recommended_redesign.what_would_actually_settle_it: tightening the objective tolerance until the per-cycle change at termination is below the signal. That is a parameter change and is NOT authorized here; its cost is the indicative figure above, with the extrapolation warning attached.

if_run_as_originally_posed.cells: cold_adaptive + warm_adaptive on a second candidate, same formulation, instance recorded per the eighth rule
if_run_as_originally_posed.predeclared_outcome: INDETERMINATE -- the offset difference between candidates will be reported, but any value under ~7.7e5 is inside the error bar and cannot distinguish 'reproduces to 33 units' from 'varies by 10^5'. Predeclaring this prevents the result from being read as support for either conclusion.
